messages:
ada: Flagging a weird accounting race that caused a route throttle + a confusing provisional dip for a customer. looks like cross-ledger-shard commit ordering.
mike: cross-shard? walk me through the sequence you observed.
ada: clipped timeline from trace: client did a streaming request that included a toolcall. sampler emitted stream prefix (credited) and a separate toolcall credit. ledger_shard_A committed the stream tokens first; aggregator updated confirmed_stream. quota check ran and throttled. ~20s later ledger_shard_B applied a dedupe adjustment for the toolcall and lowered confirmed_total which made provisional go negative in the console. customer got throttled while final billed amount was lower.
jules: that’s new to me. our ledger is sharded by session_hash and toolcalls can be routed by toolcall_id; if those route differently you can get partial commits visible to aggregator.
nate: paste the log snippet?
ada: logs below:
```
[08:42:10.110] sample sess=s-881 prefix=70 toolcall=0 prov_tokens=70
[08:42:10.210] toolcall id=tc-900 tokens=25 credited_toolcall=true
[08:42:10.300] ledger_shard_A commit sess=s-881 confirmed_stream=70 confirmed_toolcall=0
[08:42:10.350] aggregator: update confirmed_total=70 -> provisional_delta=+25 displayed
[08:42:10.360] quota check route=/gamma provisional_cost=0.045 threshold=0.04 -> THROTTLE
[08:42:32.720] ledger_shard_B commit sess=s-881 confirmed_toolcall=25 dedupe=false adjustment=+25
[08:42:32.900] ledger_shard_B later emits dedupe for duplicate toolcall id tc-900 adjustment=-25
[08:42:33.010] aggregator: apply ledger events -> confirmed_total=70 (unchanged) then adjustment -25 -> confirmed_total=45; UI provisional_delta now shows -25 transiently
```
mike: so aggregator saw only the stream commit initially, quota fired on partial confirmed view; later shard B's events adjusted confirmed counts and then deduped, causing provisional to change.
jules: root cause: aggregator treats each ledger commit as authoritative and updates provisional immediately; cross-shard ordering means partial views are possible.
nate: ops impact: customer was throttled for ~22s even though final ledger charge was below threshold. CS received angry ticket.
ops-bot: ALERT: billing-provisional-cross-shard anomalies detected for org=org-77 (sessions: s-881).
billing-bot: NOTE: final ledger confirmed charges are authoritative; provisional is an estimate.
mike: quick fixes?
jules: short-term mitigations I can think of: 1) for quota enforcement, require the ledger commit for both stream and any in-flight toolcalls before using that session's confirmed_total for route-level throttle decisions (i.e., wait for a "session_commit_watermark" event that indicates all pending shards emitted commit for that session); 2) add a small enforcement delay (hysteresis) for sessions with outstanding cross-shard markers; 3) clamp per-session provisional used for quota to not exceed session_threshold*1.25 until finalization.
ada: operationally prefer (3) + a visible console indicator for "partial-commit-pending" while we design a robust cross-shard solution. CS can then see the session was in a partially-committed state.
nate: longer-term: we should add a commit_group_id for session-scoped events so shards coalesce changes and emit a single id. aggregator would then only act on commit_group_id completeness. or implement a lightweight two-phase commit where the first phase announces "pending commit" and aggregator defers quota-impacting updates until phase two confirms. that is more intrusive.
mike: I like commit_group_id; less coupling than 2PC. it requires ledger shards to route related toolcalls/stream commits with the same group id or to publish "group_complete" when all related events for session are emitted.
jules: implementation sketch: 1) router/sampler attach session_group_hint to all samples when toolcall expected; 2) ledger shards include group_id in commit events; 3) a ledger-coordinator emits group_complete when it observed commits from all shards for that group; 4) aggregator subscribes to group_complete and only then updates quota-sensitive confirmed totals.
ada: downside: complexity and slight delay to when confirmed totals become visible; but avoids false positives for quotas and weird negative provisional dips.
ate: UX mitigation: console should show a warning badge on session lines: "partial commit pending: final billing may adjust in <30s" and in the billing inspector show last_seen_shards and group_status. also show a tooltip describing cross-shard race.
mike: agree. short-term action items: 1) implement per-session provisional cap for quota enforcement behind a feature flag (ENG-5001) so we can quickly reduce customer-visible throttles, 2) add console indicator + runbook blurb for CS (BI-14000), 3) design doc for commit_group_id / group_complete flow (ENG-5002).
ops-bot: Tickets created ENG-5001 (hotfix provisional cap) assigned @mike P1; BI-14000 (CS runbook + console wording) assigned @nate P2; ENG-5002 (design: commit_group_id) assigned @jules P1.
jules: I'll start drafting ENG-5002 and spike an internal prototype for group_complete publishing modeled as a lightweight aggregator that listens to shard heartbeats for session namespaces.
mike: I'll push the feature-flagged cap today and wire an alert when it triggers so ops can monitor. also please add unit + e2e tests that simulate shard A/B reordering and assert quota no longer fires spuriously.
ada: thanks team. please ping CS when the cap is live so we can reassure the customer and close the support ticket. :thumbsup:
